title: I connected an AI agent to a $10.21 trading account. Now I need help understanding what actually works.
author: Top-Experience4408
selftext:
Hey everyone, I could really use some guidance.

The screenshot shows my Walt account with $10.21 USDT and an agent named “ChatGPT,” marked as managed by Codex. But a connected agent isn’t the same as a working autonomous trading system—and I’m struggling to bridge that gap.

My goal is to let an agent trade autonomously within strict limits and see whether it can grow this tiny balance. I understand it could lose the entire amount.

Has anyone here actually built something like this?

• What handles continuous execution outside the chat?
• What can Walt’s integration genuinely do, and what still requires manual approval?
• How do you enforce loss limits and an emergency stop?
• Is $10.21 even practical after fees and minimum order sizes?
• Are there open-source examples with documented results, including failures?

I only have an Android phone, so that’s another constraint.

I’m feeling stuck between impressive AI demos and getting something useful to run. An honest explanation, a reproducible setup, or even “I tried this and here’s why it failed” would help enormously.

Please share advice publicly in the comments so others can learn too. Thank you.
